name: USMLE Step 1 Prep: Stethari
subtitle: Step 1 vignettes, labs, mocks
shortDescription: 2,572 original USMLE Step 1 practice questions, a lesson for every outline point, function labs and timed blocks. Works offline.
longDescription:
USMLE Step 1 Prep: Stethari is a study app built around the official USMLE content outline: every one of the 303 points of the USMLE Content Outline (2026) has its own lesson and at least 8 original questions. The Coverage screen in the app shows the exact count, point by point.

### Practice
- 2,572 original questions, most of them clinical vignettes, each with five options and a reason for every option, the reasoning steps and the trap
- Timed blocks of 20 questions in 30 minutes, plus a three-block run
- A diagnostic that finds weak systems, spaced review and a mistake notebook

### Learn
- 303 short lessons that follow the outline, each citing authoritative open sources that open inside the app
- Function labs with typeset equations: pressure-volume loop, acid-base from a blood gas, repeat-dose drug levels and screening-test statistics
- Guided clinical cases with your own written work-up
- Adult lab reference ranges

### It Adapts to You
The app tracks each concept on your device, links every missed question back to its lesson, suggests the next best concept with a reason, and lets you study in outline order or by clinical case.

### Comfortable to Read
Light, high-contrast design, text size from 50 to 300 percent, and wide layouts for tablets. Works offline. No account. A notice on first launch explains the optional usage sharing, which you can switch off or on at any time, and you can send feedback and suggestions from the app.

A study aid for exam preparation, not medical advice. Practice scores are not a prediction of any exam result. Questions are original; there are no real or released exam items. USMLE is a joint program of the FSMB and NBME. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by USMLE, NBME, FSMB or ECFMG.
